arStrings.szText: I descended into the tunnels for my shift, but before I could even swing my pick, a flash of white stone caught my eye. Of course, I immediately recognized it as a Firstborn structure and knew that it had to be excavated.
But, alas! I was not the only one stirred by the discovery. A beast thrashed forward, like some terrible guard dog! My supposed friends have refused to help me go back.
